require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'json'
require 'set'
require 'digest'
require 'thread'

module AuthGateway
  class ReplayProtection
    MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 100_000
    
    def initialize
      @seen_tokens = Set.new
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @window_start = Time.now.to_i
    end

    def check_and_record!(token_fingerprint)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        rotate_window_if_needed!
        if @seen_tokens.include?(token_fingerprint)
          raise SecurityError, 'Token replay detected'
        end
        @seen_tokens.add(token_fingerprint)
      end
    end

    private

    def rotate_window_if_needed!
      now = Time.now.to_i
      if now - @window_start > 300
        @seen_tokens.clear
        @window_start = now
      end
    end
  end

  class SignatureVerifier
    CURVES = {
      'ES256' => { digest: 'SHA256', key_size: 32, curve: 'prime256v1' },
      'ES384' => { digest: 'SHA384', key_size: 48, curve: 'secp384r1' },
      'ES512' => { digest: 'SHA512', key_size: 66, curve: 'secp521r1' }
    }.freeze

    ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS = CURVES.keys.freeze

    def initialize(public_key_pem)
      @public_key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(public_key_pem)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Key must be public only' if @public_key.private_key?
    end

    def verify(algorithm, signing_input, signature_bytes)
      raise SecurityError, 'Unsupported algorithm' unless ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS.include?(algorithm)
      
      curve_info = CURVES[algorithm]
      digest = OpenSSL::Digest.new(curve_info[:digest])
      
      # Convert raw R||S signature to DER format for OpenSSL
      der_sig = raw_to_der(signature_bytes, curve_info[:key_size])
      
      @public_key.dsa_verify_asn1(
        digest.digest(signing_input),
        der_sig
      )
    end

    private

    def raw_to_der(raw, key_size)
      expected_len = key_size * 2
      raise SecurityError, 'Invalid signature length' unless raw.bytesize == expected_len
      
      r_bytes = raw[0...key_size]
      s_bytes = raw[key_size...expected_len]
      
      r_der = encode_der_integer(r_bytes)
      s_der = encode_der_integer(s_bytes)
      
      sequence_content = r_der + s_der
      encode_der_sequence(sequence_content)
    end

    def encode_der_integer(bytes)
      # Remove leading zeros
      bytes = bytes.sub(/\A\x00+/, '')
      bytes = "\x00" if bytes.empty?
      
      # Add padding if high bit set (positive integer in DER)
      if bytes.getbyte(0) >= 0x80
        bytes = "\x00" + bytes
      end
      
      "\x02" + encode_der_length(bytes.bytesize) + bytes
    end

    def encode_der_length(len)
      if len < 0x80
        [len].pack('C')
      elsif len < 0x100
        [0x81, len].pack('CC')
      else
        [0x82, len].pack('Cn')
      end
    end

    def encode_der_sequence(content)
      "\x30" + encode_der_length(content.bytesize) + content
    end
  end

  class TokenValidator
    def initialize(public_key_pem)
      @verifier = SignatureVerifier.new(public_key_pem)
      @replay_guard = ReplayProtection.new
    end

    def validate!(token_string)
      parts = token_string.split('.')
      raise SecurityError, 'Malformed token' unless parts.length == 3

      header_json = base64url_decode(parts[0])
      payload_json = base64url_decode(parts[1])
      signature = base64url_decode(parts[2])

      header = JSON.parse(header_json, symbolize_names: true)
      payload = JSON.parse(payload_json, symbolize_names: true)

      validate_header!(header)
      
      signing_input = "#{parts[0]}.#{parts[1]}"
      
      unless @verifier.verify(header[:alg], signing_input, signature)
        raise SecurityError, 'Invalid signature'
      end

      # Replay protection: use raw signature bytes as fingerprint
      # Each unique token has a unique signature
      fingerprint = compute_fingerprint(signature)
      @replay_guard.check_and_record!(fingerprint)

      validate_claims!(payload)
      payload
    end

    private

    def compute_fingerprint(signature_bytes)
      # Use the raw signature bytes directly as the replay cache key
      # This is efficient since signatures are already unique per-token
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(signature_bytes)
    end

    def validate_header!(header)
      raise SecurityError, 'Missing algorithm' unless header[:alg]
      raise SecurityError, 'None algorithm forbidden' if header[:alg].downcase == 'none'
      raise SecurityError, 'Algorithm not allowed' unless SignatureVerifier::ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS.include?(header[:alg])
      raise SecurityError, 'Invalid type' if header[:typ] && header[:typ] != 'JWT'
    end

    def validate_claims!(payload)
      now = Time.now.to_i
      
      raise SecurityError, 'Token expired' if payload[:exp] && payload[:exp] < now - 30
      raise SecurityError, 'Token not yet valid' if payload[:nbf] && payload[:nbf] > now + 30
      raise SecurityError, 'Missing issuer' unless payload[:iss]
      raise SecurityError, 'Missing subject' unless payload[:sub]
      raise SecurityError, 'Token too old' if payload[:iat] && payload[:iat] < now - 3600
    end

    def base64url_decode(str)
      str = str.tr('-_', '+/')
      padding = (4 - str.length % 4) % 4
      str += '=' * padding
      Base64.decode64(str)
    end
  end
